name: SiCSem Private Limited
capabilities: Manufacturing of SiC Diodes and MOSFETs
Assembly, test, mark, package (ATMP) for power modules
summary: SiCSem Private Limited is an integrated device manufacturer specializing in Silicon Carbide (SiC) semiconductors. They offer comprehensive manufacturing capabilities, including SiC crystal growth, semiconductor fabrication for Diodes and MOSFETs, and packaging of discrete devices and power modules. Their products target high-growth markets such as electric vehicles, renewable energy, and industrial equipment.
